Running Gemma 2 Locally in Python with Zero Cloud APIs

With Google releasing Gemma 2 weights, Python developers no longer need to depend on expensive commercial LLM APIs with privacy concerns. Using Ollama as the local inference runner, you can execute ollama pull gemma2:2b and interact with it over a local REST endpoint or the native Python client. The 2B model runs easily within 3GB of RAM, enabling completely offline automation scripts, local summarizers, and autonomous developer workflows with zero token bills.

Projects & Tools

uv: Extremely Fast Python Package Manager

astral-sh/uv — An extremely fast Python package and virtual environment manager written in Rust. Replaces pip, pip-tools, and virtualenv with 10x-100x faster package resolution and multi-threaded wheel installations.

Rich 13.7: Beautiful Terminal Formatting

Textualize/rich — Python library for rich text and beautiful formatting in the terminal, including animated progress bars, syntax-highlighted code blocks, and markdown tables.
